New: after document_search the web search is locked for the rest of that answer too (a document could otherwise carry its content away). File names go to the model only quoted, shortened and without data markers. API: GET /api/profile/wissen, PUT /api/profile/wissen/{id} (use), GET /api/profile/wissen/{id}/file (?view=1 for pictures and PDFs), GET /api/profile/wissen/{id}/text (also for the iPhone app with "documents from the app"), POST /api/profile/wissen/search, POST /api/profile/wissen/picture; all need a profile login, changes only from the own browser, rate limit doc. Self-tests: app/tests/test_wissen.py.

head: Voice chat
title: Document status (V01.0.228)
text: Document status (V01.0.228): under Zustand → Monitoring the card “Own documents” appears once the admin switches on “Read pictures and scans” or “Meaning search” (GET /api/admin/wissen, admin login only). It shows the meaning model's state (off, starting, running with its memory in MiB, waiting for 8.5 GiB free memory, error with reason), how many pieces already have a meaning vector, how many pages still wait to be read, how many were read today and when last. These are sums over all profiles, never profile or document names or contents.

head: Voice chat
title: Progress (V01.0.232)
text: Progress (V01.0.232): under Ich → Dokumente every document still being read shows "page 3 of 12 read" with a bar and why it is not moving right now: "reading page 4 now", "waits for a quiet minute" (someone talks to the assistant), "daily limit reached, continues tomorrow" or "Read pictures and scans is off". With meaning search it then shows "meaning 40 of 120" (and whether the model waits for free memory). While something runs and the list is open, it refreshes every 10 seconds. Everyone sees only their own documents. The iPhone app shows "page x of y read".

head: Voice chat
title: Shared documents (V01.0.236)
text: Shared documents (V01.0.236): with the admin switch *Funktionen → Eigene Dokumente → Gemeinsame Dokumente* and the profile switch *Ich → Dokumente → Gemeinsame Dokumente* (both off by default) every finished document gets "For everyone". A ticked document stays in its owner's database and is not read again; every other profile with the switch on finds it in its search (source "…, geteilt von name") and sees it under "Shared for everyone by others" with "View". Only the owner takes the sharing back, changes or deletes the document; the admin sees under Zustand → Monitoring what is shared and can take it back. Guests, Telegram without "personal" and voices a shared speaker does not recognize as its owner get no shared documents. Their text stays outside text like any document. Agents still search only their own documents.

head: Voice chat
title: Complete scans and reading again (V01.0.238)
text: Complete scans and reading again (V01.0.238): scanned PDF pages (less than 40 characters of text) are rendered as whole pages with pypdfium2 (fixed version 4.30.0, about 30 MB of memory for a moment per page) and handed to the language model. Up to V01.0.236 the Spark only took the biggest embedded picture; scanners storing a page as strips or JBIG2 lost pages that way. Up to 300 scanned pages per document are read (30 before), still at most 100 per profile and day; the rest follows on the next days, up to 600 pages may wait per profile. The document names any limit that applies ("only the first 300 of 412 pages without text", "2 pages without a readable picture skipped", "pages without text not read (Read pictures and scans is off)"). "Read again" under Ich → Dokumente reads a document once more from its kept original (owner only, only with "Keep originals"); place, "For everyone" and "The assistant searches it" stay. A document attached to a question in the iPhone app still takes along only its first 20,000 characters; the answer then says it is only the beginning and that under "My documents" the whole text is searched.

head: Voice chat
title: Read long documents at night (V01.0.240)
text: Read long documents at night (V01.0.240): admin switch under *Funktionen → Eigene Dokumente → Bilder und Scans lesen* (chat.doc_night, off) with a night window (doc_night_from/doc_night_to, default 01:00 to 06:00, may cross midnight). By day the Spark reads in quiet moments only documents with at most 10 waiting pages; longer ones only after 30 minutes without a question, or in the night window. At night pages are counted apart, up to 400 per profile and night on top of the daily limit of 100. Speech still comes first (vorrang.py). Ich → Dokumente names the reason: "long document, read at night from 01:00" or "daily limit reached, continues at night from 01:00".

head: Voice chat
title: Size and space (V01.0.242)
text: Size and space (V01.0.242): PDFs may be up to 100 MB; the admin sets 20 to 300 MB under *Funktionen → Eigene Dokumente → Größte PDF-Datei* (chat.doc_max_mb); all other kinds of files stay at 20 MB. Uploads that are too big are refused before they are read; the page says so before uploading. The "space per profile" (chat.doc_quota_mb, default 500 MB) now counts all uploads of a profile together (database with text, meaning vectors and waiting pages plus originals). When it is full, the Spark takes nothing new; originals are kept only while there is room. Ich → Dokumente shows "Used: 120 MB of 500 MB" with a bar. Under Zustand → Monitoring the admin sees per profile how much is used and gives single profiles their own value (50 to 50,000 MB, state/doc-quotas.json, in the backup).

head: Voice chat
title: Read on (V01.0.243)
text: Read on (V01.0.243): "View" shows the stored text in parts of about 200,000 characters; "Read on" fetches the next part (GET /api/profile/wissen/{id}/text?start=). Only the view is split, the search always uses the whole text (up to 2 million characters per document).

head: Voice chat
title: Document card and tags (V01.0.245)
text: Document card and tags (V01.0.245): admin switch *Funktionen → Eigene Dokumente → Steckbrief und Tags* (chat.doc_brief) and profile switch *Ich → Dokumente → Steckbrief und Tags* (both off). In quiet minutes (speech priority applies) the language model reads the beginning of each finished document once (up to 3,000 characters, wrapped as outside text) and notes title, kind (contract, invoice, insurance, manual …), sender, date, deadline, number and 3 to 6 tags; at most 200 a day, existing documents bit by bit without being read again. The fields are checked (length, characters, date YYYY-MM[-DD], kind from a fixed list). Instead of file names the assistant sees one line per document (with many, the 30 that fit the question best, plus all tags) and can narrow document_search with tags or art; when no passage matches it gets the fitting cards. Under *Ich → Dokumente* title, kind, deadline and tags show at the document; tags filter the list (also the ones others share), "Tags" sets own ones (empty = the automatic ones again; owner only). "View" shows "Belongs with": documents with the same number, the same sender or two tags in common. With the profile switch *Fristen anbieten* (doc_d

head: Voice chat
title: Document card and tags (V01.0.245)
text: ue, off) a deadline gets a "Remind" button (six weeks before at 9:00, else the day before); the assistant never sets a reminder from a deadline in a document by itself. Also document_search now always stays offered in a narrowed tool set, and more words (insurance, policy, warranty, manual, notice, cancellation period, tax, doctor's letter, findings, receipt, certificate …) count as a question about documents.

head: Voice chat
title: Picture recognition (V01.0.190, off by default)
text: Picture recognition (V01.0.190, off by default): a profile attaches a photo in the assistant (picture button next to the text field, paste or drop; up to three per question) and asks about it, typed or spoken. qwen38's language model (Qwen3.8 can see pictures) looks at it itself. Switches: the admin under Features → Picture recognition, where "Check picture recognition" sends a test picture to see whether the running lane accepts pictures; each profile under Me → Conversation → "Pictures to the assistant", for the iPhone app also "Let the model look at photos from the app", for Telegram "Photos over Telegram" (caption = question, reply to the photo = follow-up). Never guests, speakers or other device keys. The browser makes the picture smaller; the Spark reads it again (Pillow, at most 8 MB and 40 megapixels, JPEG/PNG/WebP only, with a time limit), turns it upright, scales it to 1280 pixels and writes it again as JPEG, so location (GPS) and camera data are gone. It is kept in memory only, bound to profile and device, 10 minutes after the last question (30 minutes at most, 3 per profile, 30 per hour), never on disk, in the backup or the log, unless the person keeps it with "Picture

head: Voice chat
title: Picture recognition (V01.0.190, off by default)
text: to My documents" (see knowledge from uploads). In an answer with a picture the model gets no tools; the answer counts as outside text, the next turn is locked like after a web page, and nothing is learned from it. Below the answer, "Store under My documents" keeps the answer text. API: POST /api/chat/image (raw picture) → {"id"}, then POST /api/chat with "images": [id]; GET /api/chat/image says whether the caller may.

head: Voice chat
title: Messages in the conversation
text: Messages in the conversation: hovering over a message (on a phone: tapping it) shows a bin and, on answers, a speaker. The bin deletes the message, a question together with its answer. The speaker reads the answer out again.

head: Voice chat
title: Timers and reminders
text: Timers and reminders: "remind me about the oven in 10 minutes" or "remind me tomorrow at 8 about the appointment". Pending reminders show as small chips below the toggles (✕ cancels); "which timers are running?" and "cancel the oven timer" work by voice too. When one is due, the page chimes, shows it in the conversation and speaks it; if the tab is in the background, a browser notification appears as well. This works while the page is open. Profiles keep their reminders on the Spark, guests only in their own browser. Since V01.0.176 a profile's reminder rings only once: the first device that plays it (an open page, the iPhone app or push) takes it on the Spark, all others stay silent. While a page of the profile is open, push waits 20 seconds so the reminder does not ring there and arrive as a notification too. A reminder that was more than 10 minutes overdue when the page opens shows quietly in the conversation ("Missed"). The iPhone app without Apple push rings with its own alarms; if it is closed then, it reports that the next time it opens. At the same moment as an open page it can then still ring twice; with Apple push it does not. Can be turned off under Features.

head: Voice chat
title: Reminders as notifications
text: Reminders as notifications (profiles only): in the "Ich" window under "Conversation", "Reminders on this device → Switch on" turns on push notifications. A reminder then arrives also when the page is closed, and only on the devices of that profile. This needs https with a valid certificate (e.g. behind a reverse proxy); on an iPhone first add the page to the home screen ("Share → Add to Home Screen"). The Spark only sends to the browsers' push services (Apple, Google, Mozilla, Microsoft), encrypted. Since V01.0.181 every notification (reminder, "speaking up" note, morning briefing, agent report) arrives once: on the device the profile used last (an open page, the iPhone app or Telegram, at most 12 hours back), else the iPhone app, else Telegram, else the browser set up last. Private notes go over Telegram only when the profile allowed personal data there.

head: Voice chat
title: Daily briefing as a notification
text: Daily briefing as a notification (profiles only): below that, each profile sets a time under "Tagesbriefing als Mitteilung" (daily briefing as notification). Every morning at that time a short briefing (appointments, reminders, unread mail, your topics) then goes to all devices of the profile with notifications on, and it is also kept in the history. "Aus" (off) turns it off.

head: Voice chat
title: Daily briefing and calendar
text: Daily briefing and calendar: say "good morning" or "what's on today?" and the assistant reads out today's and tomorrow's appointments, today's reminders and a few lines on your own topics (e.g. "weather Berlin", via your SearXNG). "What do I have on Friday?" works too. Each profile connects one or more calendars (up to 8) in the "Ich" window, tab Calendar; an appointment found in two calendars is read out once. Each one is a CalDAV address with user and app password (iCloud: https://caldav.icloud.com with the Apple ID and an app-specific password from appleid.apple.com; Nextcloud: …/remote.php/dav; Radicale …), or a subscription link with webcal://, webcals:// or https:// (Google: "secret address in iCal format", a public iCloud calendar). New appointments: "put dentist on Tuesday 10 am in my calendar" makes the assistant read out a proposal; only when you answer with a plain yes in the same conversation does the panel itself write it to the first CalDAV calendar (optionally with an alarm). Subscription links stay read only. The password stays on the Spark and is never shown again. Guests get no calendar. Can be turned off under Features.

head: Voice chat
title: Reading e-mail
text: Reading e-mail: "Any new mail?", "What does Anna write?", "Read me the mail from the bank". Each profile connects up to 4 mailboxes over IMAP in the "Ich" window, tab E-mail: iCloud (imap.mail.me.com, your iCloud mail address and a new app-specific password from appleid.apple.com), Gmail (imap.gmail.com, app password, needs 2-step verification), GMX and web.de (allow IMAP in their settings first) or any other IMAP server with TLS. Outlook/Microsoft 365 is not supported yet (needs OAuth). The assistant only reads the inbox of the last 30 days and changes nothing: the mailbox is opened read only, no mail is sent, deleted, moved or marked as read. It summarizes mails and reads them out word for word only when asked; the daily briefing names the unread ones. Mail text is treated as someone else's words: once the assistant read a mail in an answer, in that answer it cannot switch smart home devices, change memory, cancel reminders, search the web or enter appointments, so a crafted mail cannot trigger anything; answers made from mails are not learned into memory. Guests and another person's voice at a different device get no access. The password is stored encrypted on the Spark and neve

head: Voice chat
title: Reading e-mail
text: r shown again. Off until turned on under Features.

head: Voice chat
title: Inbox tidying
text: Inbox tidying (Features → "Postfach aufräumen", off by default; needs reading e-mail; profiles only): the Spark sorts advertising, newsletters, invoices, notifications and social media mail into folders under a main folder (Spark/ unless renamed, e.g. Spark/Werbung; renamed in the "Ich" window under E-mail, empty puts the folders at the top. Renaming also renames them in the mailbox with IMAP RENAME, the mail moves along; if the new name exists already, the old folder stays) so the inbox keeps only what matters. It only moves; it never deletes, never sends and never marks mail as read. When the server has no IMAP MOVE (iCloud), it copies the mail into the target folder, checks that the copy arrived, and only then removes exactly that original from the inbox (UIDPLUS); no other mail is touched. Each profile picks per mailbox in the "Ich" window, tab E-mail, part "Postfach aufräumen": off, preview (only shows what it would move; a week is recommended to start), safe automatic (moves only what a rule or clear headers such as List-Unsubscribe prove) or fully automatic (also when the model is at least 85 % sure). Only new mail is checked, every 5, 15 (default) or 60 minutes. Who decides

head: Voice chat
title: Inbox tidying
text: , in this order: people you wrote to (sent folder), sign-in and security mails and your "always keep" list stay put; then your rules (sender or @domain); then fixed headers; only then the language model, which may only return a category from the fixed list and has no tools. It asks first for invoices and notifications and for unclear mail; your answer can become a rule. Move a mail back into the inbox and it is not moved again, and the Spark asks. Brakes: at most 200 mails per run, and a run that would move more than half of at least 10 new mails stops and puts everything into the preview. Every move stays in the history for 30 days and can be undone. "Old mail" proposes once where the last 90 days belong; nothing moves until you press "Move". By voice: "Tidy my inbox", "Move everything from Lidl to advertising", "Undo that"; the assistant reads out a proposal and the panel carries it out only after your plain "yes". Reply drafts (per mailbox): "Write Anna that I'm coming" saves a draft in the drafts folder after your "yes"; you send it yourself in your mail app. Guests and other people's voices get no access.

head: Voice chat
title: Writing help (V01.0.332, `schreib.py`)
text: Writing help (V01.0.332, schreib.py): improve mails and other texts (also from Word, Excel, Pages). Switches: Features → Mail and contacts → "Schreibhilfe" (admin, off) and Me → Writing help → "Use the writing help for me" (profile, off); never guests. On the page Me → Writing help: paste a text, pick what to do (Correct: only spelling, grammar, punctuation; Smooth; Shorter; Friendlier; More formal; Translate into German, English, French, Spanish, Italian or Dutch; Draft a reply from the mail you received and your own notes, missing details come as [square brackets]), optionally a free wish about the form ("informal", sign-off). When correcting, smoothing, shortening and rephrasing the panel shows every change in colour; the panel works out the changes itself (word comparison), not the model. "Copy", "Use as my text" (for a second round). With "Picture recognition", "Read from picture" or a screenshot pasted with Ctrl+V reads the text from a picture (the picture is dropped right after). With "Reading e-mail", "Inbox tidying" and the mailbox switch "Drafts", "Put into the mailbox as a draft" saves the text in the drafts folder; nothing is ever sent. For other programs there is the M

head: Voice chat
title: Writing help (V01.0.332, `schreib.py`)
text: CP tool write_text ("Improve text") under Me → Services over MCP. The text is data only: a single call of the language model without tools, between fixed marks, told never to follow requests in the text. Nothing is stored (no history, no memory); the journal, Logs → Requests and Status → Live see only the kind, the number of characters and the time. Limits: 20,000 characters of text and mail, 96 KB per request, one request per profile at a time, two on the whole Spark, 20 per minute. Notaus stage 3 stops the writing help, from stage 2 there are no drafts. Plan: plaene/schreibhilfe.md.

head: Voice chat
title: Writing help in other programs (V01.0.339)
text: Writing help in other programs (V01.0.339): sub-switches Features → Schreibhilfe → "In other programs" (admin, off) and Me → Writing help → "Use in other programs" (profile, off). Then Me → Writing help shows the programs to download and "Pair a program": one click (with confirmation code) gives a setup line like https://spark.example.de#schreib=ABCD-EFGH, valid 10 minutes, usable once. The program swaps it for its own device key of kind "write" that can only improve texts (no chat, no mail, no drafts, no history). Paired programs are listed below and can be removed one by one; at most 10 per profile. - Mac (download "Mac quick action"): Services menu "Mit Spark verbessern" in Apple Mail, Pages, Word, Excel and any other program, optionally with a shortcut. Pick what to do, look at the suggestion, "Übernehmen" replaces the selection. Key in the keychain. - Windows (x64 and ARM): since V01.0.342 part of the Spark companion (below), paired under Me → Companion. - Outlook, Word, Excel (Office add-in, only with the Spark's https address): download the manifest and load it in Outlook under "Get Add-ins" → "My add-ins" → "Custom add-in", or in Word/Excel as a shared add-in. Side pane wit

head: Voice chat
title: Writing help in other programs (V01.0.339)
text: h kind, suggestion and "Übernehmen" into the mail, document or cell. Works in Outlook for Windows, Mac and the web. - Browser (extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox): right-click selected text in webmailers (Outlook on the web, Gmail, GMX, web.de and others) → "Mit Spark verbessern". Load as unpacked extension; in Firefox only until restart. - iPhone and iPad (Spark app): Share → Spark → "Improve text" and the shortcut "Improve text with Spark"; uses the app key. All programs send only the selected text, the Spark does not store it; http only in the home network. Live and logs show program kind, kind and number of characters.

head: Voice chat
title: Spark companion on PC and Mac (V01.0.342, `begleiter.py`, `tools/begleiter`)
text: Spark companion on PC and Mac (V01.0.342, begleiter.py, tools/begleiter): a small program in the Windows taskbar (x64 and ARM, GitHub Action "Spark-Begleiter Windows", release begleiter-windows) and the Mac menu bar (macOS 13 and later, Action "Spark-Begleiter Mac", release begleiter-mac). Switches: Features → On the go and devices → "Spark companion on PC and Mac" (admin, off) and Me → Companion → "Spark companion for me" (profile, off); never guests. Pairing: Me → Companion → "Pair a device" gives a setup line …#begleiter=ABCD-EFGH (10 minutes, once, with confirmation code); the program gets its own key of kind "desk" that knows only its own paths. Parts, on or off per device under Me → Companion (new devices: writing help, Ask Spark, notes and state on; dictation and the kill-switch button off): - Writing help (needs the writing help itself): select text, Ctrl+Alt+S (Mac ⌥⌘S or the Services menu). Defaults per device: kind, language for translating, fixed wish, which kinds show in the menu, show the suggestion first or replace at once. - Ask Spark: Ctrl+Alt+A (⌥⌘A) opens a window for a question, the answer comes as text; follow-ups within 10 minutes keep the context, a day's que

head: Voice chat
title: Spark companion on PC and Mac (V01.0.342, `begleiter.py`, `tools/begleiter`)
text: stions are a conversation "Begleiter" in the history. - Dictation: Ctrl+Alt+D (⌥⌘D) starts and ends the recording (at most 60 seconds, visible indicator), the recognised text lands at the cursor. Language per device. - Notes: the Spark's notes as system notifications when the companion is the device used last (like the Android app, the program fetches them every 30 seconds). - State dot: icon normal, grey (Spark not reachable) or red (Notaus or my kill switch). - My kill switch: menu item with a confirmation, stops the own profile (as Me → Security). Lifting only in the browser with the PIN. Hotkeys are set in the program under Settings. Changes in the panel reach the program with its next check. Removing a device under Me → Companion stops its key at once. Windows: not signed, SmartScreen on first start ("More info" → "Run anyway"), key encrypted with DPAPI. Mac: not notarized yet, first start right-click → Open; for the writing-help hotkey and pasting macOS asks once for "Accessibility", for dictation for the microphone; key in the keychain. Status → Live shows pairing, questions, dictations (character count only) and notes to "Spark-Begleiter".

head: Voice chat
title: Companion: updates, look, coffee (V01.0.347)
text: Companion: updates, look, coffee (V01.0.347): The programs now look like the panel: the Spark face as icon in taskbar and menu bar (dot bottom right: green reachable, grey not reachable, red kill switch, accent colour when a new version is there), a window on clicking the icon with all parts that are on and their hotkeys, light and dark look following the system. Updates: the Spark fetches new versions itself from the GitHub releases begleiter-windows and begleiter-mac (once a day and only when a device of that kind is paired; Features → Spark companion → "Fetch new version now" at once) and checks size and SHA-256 against the version's begleiter.json. The program learns from its check that a new version is there, downloads it only from the paired Spark, checks size and SHA-256 again and installs only after your click on "Update"; a damaged file is deleted and the old version keeps running. Settings → About shows the version, "Check for updates" and the switch "Download updates automatically, ask before installing". The first version with updates has to be installed by hand once. The program and Me → Companion carry the link "☕ Support Spark" (buymeacoffee.com).

head: Voice chat
title: Companion deeper in the computer (V01.0.353)
text: Companion deeper in the computer (V01.0.353): eight more parts, all off, turned on per device under Me → Companion: - Right-click on files: "With Spark" in Explorer (Windows 11: "Show more options") and under Services in Finder: summarize, translate, explain (PDF, Office, text, mail, pictures; at most 20 MB, the first 40,000 characters are read) or add to knowledge (needs own documents). - Ask about the screen: Ctrl+Alt+B (⌥⌘B), drag a region, optionally a question, then explain, read out the text or translate. The language model reads the picture; it is kept nowhere. - Know the app: the writing help learns the kind of program (mail, Word, Excel, chat, browser …) and fits tone and form; program names and window titles do not go to the Spark. - Draft a reply: Ctrl+Alt+M (⌥⌘M) for the open mail in Outlook (classic, Windows) or Apple Mail: the answer is a draft in the reply window; nothing is ever sent. In the new Outlook it is on the clipboard. - Spark-Wissen folder: what lands in the folder (default: Spark-Wissen in the user folder) goes into the own documents; a changed file replaces its older version, at most 50 a day. - Buttons in notes: Reply, Later, Open panel. A reply goes to

head: Voice chat
title: Companion deeper in the computer (V01.0.353)
text: the Spark with the note as context; the note counts as outside text (nothing switches). - Act on the PC (own admin switch "May act on the PC", off): for a request like "Open tagesschau.de on the PC" the computer asks in a window whether it may (60 s, else no). Allowed only: open a page (http/https), a program released under Me → Companion, music (play, pause, next, previous), volume, lock the screen, show a text. Locked after mail, web pages or other outside text. - Wake word on the PC: "Hey Spark" through the computer's microphone, as in the browser (short pieces to speech recognition, a hit starts the question). Listens only while the part is on; the icon shows it, "Pause wake word" in the window.

head: Voice chat
title: Room mode
text: Room mode (Features → "Raum-Modus", off by default; profiles only): the switch "Raum" below the face lets the assistant listen to the conversation in the room at this device for a chosen time (15 minutes to 4 hours, it ends by itself); an orange dot shows it. In a pause it helps when a fixed cue came up: an open question (with web search, nothing when in doubt), an appointment ("Shall I enter it?"), "cold", "too warm" or "too dark" (the room's real temperature from Home Assistant, offering to change the heating by one degree or switch on the light) and things to buy (Home Assistant shopping list). It changes something only after a "yes", for the smart home with the code word when one is set. In the "Ich" window under "Raum-Modus" each device sets the duration, how much it may say (questions only, also hints, also comments), each kind on its own, the device's room in Home Assistant and "text only" (silently in the conversation instead of spoken). What it hears stays in the panel's memory for five minutes and is never stored; room mode uses neither memory, mail nor earlier conversations. Everyone in the room should know it is listening. Since V01.0.95 it also offers a timer ("The piz

head: Voice chat
title: Room mode
text: za needs 12 more minutes") and a reminder ("I must not forget to call grandma"), both only after a "yes", and calculates unit questions ("How much is 180 degrees in Fahrenheit?"). A question that points back ("When did he die?") is completed from the last sentences, only with words that were said. With a taught voice and speaker identification on, only the profile's own voice can say "yes". A soft tone comes before it speaks; "Stopp" ends the sentence, "Nicht jetzt" keeps it quiet for 15 minutes, "Raummodus aus" (also "Hör auf zuzuhören") switches it off, from any voice. Since V01.0.126 the profile's quiet hours apply (Ich → Von selbst, 22 to 7 by default): then everything appears as text only, never spoken. When the page is in the background or the phone locked for more than two minutes (the microphone hears nothing there anyway), room mode ends with its summary; closing the tab ends it at once. Since V01.0.128 it also runs on the own ESP32 speakers, all board variants: "Raummodus an" after the wake word or the switch "Room" under Me → Speakers (when the speaker sleeps, it starts at its next wake word), where duration, how much it may say and the room in Home Assistant are set per

head: Voice chat
title: Room mode
text: speaker. The Spark keeps the connection open, cuts out every sentence, runs it through speech recognition and speaks in a pause after the soft tone; boards with a display show the sentence. It ends after its time, with "Raummodus aus", the switch, when the connection drops or when the admin or the profile switch it off; then the board waits for its wake word again. In quiet hours the speaker stays silent. Since V01.0.140 the speaker cuts long stretches of talk after at most 8 seconds and checks every sentence on its own, speaks after 1.5 seconds of quiet (counted from the last loud sound, not from the end of a piece), streams the speech, and each speaker has "detect more". Questions are now recognized without a question mark from the speech recognition ("Wie hoch ist die Zugspitze"), after "Sag mal" or "Weißt du, wann …" and with "Stimmt es, dass …"; questions about the people in the room ("Wo ist meine Brille") stay out. The answer is looked up while people still talk and is ready in the pause (in the browser too). "Also comments" is chattier: at most every two minutes, after three seconds of quiet, one casual sentence about the conversation. Since V01.0.142 Me → Speakers has "St

head: Voice chat
title: Room mode
text: imme hier anlernen" (speaker identification on, browser login, with the second step when set up): the speaker asks for three sentences and keeps its own voiceprint for its microphone; a sentence counts for a profile when it fits any of its voiceprints (browser or speaker). Until somebody taught a voice through a speaker, it listens to everybody despite "only known voices" (log: "listens to everybody (no voice taught through it yet)"), because a voice taught in the browser is rarely recognized through the small board microphone. At most two speakers at once, because speech recognition runs all the time. While it speaks, the wake word interrupts it. Option "Genauer erkennen": the model looks for missed questions, appointments and shopping, counted only with a word-for-word quote. When room mode ends, the page shows what it said and did (not what it heard), not stored. Every decision writes a "room:" line to the log (why it spoke or stayed silent, never the heard text).

head: Voice chat
title: Ignoring TV voices
text: Ignoring TV voices (since V01.0.139; Features → Room mode → "Fernsehstimmen überhören", off by default): every device picks under Me → Room mode "Who it listens to" (speakers under Me → Speakers): *everybody* (as before, default), *only known voices while the TV is on* (recommended) or *always only known voices*. A voice is known when a profile taught it under Me → Speaker identification; speaker identification must be on. It then runs for every sentence in room mode, on the CPU next to speech recognition (about 0.1 s per sentence), with no extra GPU load. Whether the TV is on comes from Home Assistant at most every 30 seconds: a media player on, playing or buffering in the device's room, without a room set anywhere in the home; when Home Assistant does not answer, it listens to everybody as before. A sentence in a foreign voice triggers no question or suggestion and is dropped at once; the model never sees it, not with "Genauer erkennen" or comments either. Always counted: a sentence starting with "Spark" (also from visitors), "Stopp", "Nicht jetzt" and "Raummodus aus". A "yes" still counts only in the profile's voice. Very short sentences (under about one second of speech) are of

head: Voice chat
title: Ignoring TV voices
text: ten not recognized and count as foreign. With *Trial* (on at first) nothing is ignored, only counted: at the end the summary and the log say "Probelauf: Von 40 Sätzen hätte ich 12 als fremde Stimme überhört.", for speakers also under *Check*. Only this number is kept, never the text or whose voice it was; the log says "room: ignored (unknown voice)" or "(unknown voice, tv on)".

head: Voice chat
title: Where it listens right now
text: Where it listens right now (since V01.0.208; part of room mode, no switch of its own): the Spark keeps a list of every device in room mode, browser pages and speakers, in memory only and only with name, kind, since/until, "who it listens to" and trial, never anything heard. A page signs in when switched on and gives a sign of life every minute; without one for three minutes (tab closed, phone locked) it drops out. After a restart it signs in again with its next sign of life. It shows (1) as a green strip on top of every page ("Kitchen listens until 21:30", View opens Me → Room mode), (2) at the face as "Also the kitchen is listening", (3) under Me → Room mode → *Active now* with *+30 min* and *Stop* (speakers waiting for their next wake word with *Do not start*), (4) for the admin under Status → *Listening right now* with profile, device and time, *Stop* and *Stop all*, and as a mark "listening" and the filter "listening right now" under People and devices. A page in room mode shows "● Room" in the tab title and a red dot on its icon. Everybody who sees the list may end a room (it only means less listening); extending only in the profile's browser login, never beyond 4 hours from n

head: Voice chat
title: Where it listens right now
text: ow. A browser's name is set under Me → Room mode → *Name of this device* (else e.g. "iPad · Safari", with a device key its name). *Reminder tone* (per device, speakers under Me → Speakers, off): the soft tone every 15 minutes, never in quiet hours. *Note when a speaker starts listening* (profile, off): when somebody says "Raummodus an" at your speaker, a note goes to the device used last, at most once an hour per speaker, never in quiet hours. *Recently*: the last 20 times within 14 days with device, time, how it ended and how many sentences were heard, said and ignored, never text (users/<profile>/room-history.json, in the backup). Home Assistant (admin: Features → Room mode → *Room mode for Home Assistant*, off): under Me → Room mode → Home Assistant the profile makes a key of its own (with the second step when set up; a new one replaces the old). It may only GET /api/room/active (count, first device, until when) and POST /api/room/end ({"all": true}), nothing else; the page shows the ready text for configuration.yaml once (REST sensor "Spark Raum-Modus", command spark_raummodus_aus). The log only says "room: listed …", "room: … ended (panel|iphone|ha|admin)" and "room: page … ga

head: Voice chat
title: Starting from afar
text: Starting from afar (since V01.0.213; admin: Features → Room mode → *Start room mode from afar* and profile: Me → Room mode → *Start room mode on another device*, both off): "Raummodus im Wohnzimmer an" (also "Kannst du den Raummodus für den Lautsprecher im Wohnzimmer aktivieren?", "… für 60 Minuten") in the panel, the iPhone app or at another speaker. The panel recognizes the sentence by fixed rules (roomfar.py); the language model gets no tools in that answer, Home Assistant is not asked and no code word is wanted. Only the profile's own speakers, found by name or by the room entered under Me → Speakers; when several fit, the answer names them. The speaker must be connected right now (it does not start later by itself; the switch "Room" is for that). Only a plain "Ja" in the next message of the same conversation (15 minutes) starts it; the speaker says "Raum-Modus an, gestartet von der iPhone-App" (or the panel, the kitchen speaker). Duration from the sentence (rounded to 15/30/60/120/240 minutes), else the speaker's own. Not via Telegram or Siri, never for guests or a voice recognized as someone else. "Raummodus im Wohnzimmer aus" / "Raummodus überall aus" ends without a question

head: Voice chat
title: Starting from afar
text: (history: "ended from another device"). With the switch off there is a fixed answer naming the switch. "Starte den Raummodus" without a place stays the device's own room mode. Log: "room: start at speaker … asked from …", "room: on at speaker … (remote from …)".

head: Voice chat
title: Speaking up by itself
text: Speaking up by itself (Features → "Von selbst melden", off by default; profiles only): each profile decides in the "Ich" window under "Von selbst" whether and why the assistant speaks unasked, each kind on its own: appointments ahead ("In 20 minutes: dentist. Shall I remind you again at 9:55?", a "yes" sets the reminder), its own smart home rules ("Whirlpool above 37.5", "bathroom window is open and rain is on", "washing machine power below 5 for 3 minutes"; read only, never switching), a short greeting with the next appointment or reminder when the conversation is opened after three hours or more, at most one follow-up a day on a plan mentioned yesterday, new mail from chosen senders (sender and subject only) and a weather note for tomorrow via web search. Plus quiet hours, a daily limit and learning from feedback: "nicht jetzt" means two hours of quiet, "das interessiert mich nicht" halves how often that kind may speak (can be reset). The panel decides when, by fixed rules from real data; where the model words something (follow-up, weather), its answer only counts when it quotes the data. With the conversation open the note is spoken, otherwise it arrives as a push notification.

head: Voice chat
title: Speaking up by itself
text: Since V01.0.179 only the first device of the profile says it (page or iPhone app), the others stay silent, just like reminders (V01.0.176). Every note is in the log with its reason.

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: Home Assistant tells the Spark (since V01.0.314, plan plaene/home-assistant-meldungen.md): the smart home rules under "Von selbst" can do more. Each rule can speak *at most every N minutes* (e.g. a motion sensor at most every 10 minutes), for "changes" *on*, *off* or both, and have an extra condition: *only when I am away* (the person in Home Assistant with your profile name or the one chosen under "Me in Home Assistant"), *only when nobody is home*, *only at night* or *only during the day* (by sun.sun, else 9 pm to 6 am). Plus five parts, each with its own admin switch under Features → Speaking up by itself and its own switch under Me → Proactive, all off at first, never for guests: *Instant notes from Home Assistant*: the Spark keeps a WebSocket connection to your Home Assistant (the same address and token, only the devices of your rules, subscribe_entities); a change arrives in about a second, also a motion sensor that triggers only briefly. If the connection drops, the Spark checks every minute again. *House notes on speakers*: a rule also says its own sentence on chosen speakers that take announcements from you, e.g. "Someone rang the bell."; only its own sentence without name

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: s, never for person devices and never with a camera picture, not in the speaker's quiet hours, at most 20 an hour. *Home Assistant tells the Spark*: a list of event names with a fixed sentence (e.g. klingel → "Es hat geklingelt.") and a key of its own; Home Assistant calls rest_command.spark_melden with event: klingel (POST /api/ha/event). Only names from the list count, nothing else from the request is read or said; at most 30 a minute, a pause per event (default 1 minute). *Smart home rule by voice*: "Sag mir Bescheid, wenn jemand an der Haustür ist", "Melde dich, wenn Anna heimkommt": the panel recognizes the sentence by fixed words, finds the device and asks "Soll ich mich melden, wenn …?"; only a "yes" in the same conversation adds the rule. *Describe a camera picture*: a rule can name a camera from Home Assistant; when it applies, the local language model describes the still in a few words. The picture is never stored, the description is outside text and goes to your devices only, at most 30 an hour. Log lines start with "hamelden:". Status → Live shows the live connection (under channels) and each note, event and described camera picture in fixed words, without device names,

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: sentences or camera words. You don't have to type devices for a rule (since V01.0.317): the field suggests all devices from Home Assistant, "Zuletzt geändert" shows the last changed ones, and with "Gerät erkennen" you trigger the sensor within 40 seconds (motion, door, bell); whatever changes shows up to tap. The panel only compares the change time Home Assistant reports itself. Rules can be edited (since V01.0.319): "Bearbeiten" brings a rule back into the form, "Prüfen und speichern" checks it like a new one and replaces it in the same place; it then starts fresh (speaks only after it was false once). Since V01.0.334 each fired rule and event shows on Status → Live as a request of "Home Assistant" (rule or event) with camera picture, note (Web Push, Apple Push, Android app, Telegram or the open page) and speaker announcement; everything else the Spark says by itself as a request of "Von selbst" (e.g. greeting, reminder, task). Never the sentence.

head: Voice chat
title: Natural turn-taking
text: Natural turn-taking (on by default, conversation settings): during a short pause the recording is transcribed already. A finished sentence ends the turn at once and its transcript becomes the question, so the answer starts noticeably sooner; after "and …", "because …", "um" or a comma the assistant waits up to 2 s for you to go on.

head: Voice chat
title: New conversation every day
text: New conversation every day (on by default, conversation settings → Display): the first question of a new day starts a new conversation; earlier ones stay in the history and can be picked and continued.

head: Voice chat
title: Speaker identification
text: Speaker identification (off by default, Features): each profile reads three short sentences in the "Ich" window. When the assistant then clearly recognizes a voice, it answers for that profile, with its memory, documents, reminders and voice, even on a guest device. The conversation shows "🎙 name" below the question. When someone other than the logged-in profile speaks at a device, the assistant gets only that one question (not the device's conversation), and the exchange stays out of the logged-in profile's history and memory. When the voice is unclear, nothing changes. Recognition runs on the Spark's CPU (Resemblyzer model, Apache 2.0) and needs no GPU memory. Strictness is adjustable. A voice is not a password: someone who sounds very similar or plays a recording can get into a profile.

head: Voice chat
title: Profiles and memory
text: Profiles and memory: under Profiles the admin creates profiles with a name and PIN. In the chat you log in with the "Guest" button at the top of the conversation by typing name and PIN. Logged in, the assistant remembers things for good when you tell it to ("remember that I'm vegetarian") or when they will be useful later, and forgets them on request; the Me lists what it knows, for deleting. Memory and conversations belong to the profile and live on the Spark, so the same history shows on every device you are logged in on: which profile is asking is decided only by the login (cookie) or the device key, never by the model, and guests get no memory. Speakers and your own programs get a device key under Profiles that belongs to one profile, and send it as the header X-Speech-Device to /api/chat. A new PIN logs out every browser of that profile; deleting a profile removes its memory and devices. The data lives on the Spark under /var/lib/speech-spark/users, one folder per profile.

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant
text: Home Assistant (Funktionen → "Home Assistant", off by default): each profile connects its own Home Assistant in the "Ich" window under "Smart home" with the address (e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123) and a long-lived access token (Home Assistant: your profile → Security; best for a separate non-admin user). Then "turn on the living room light" or "how warm is it in the bathroom?" work in the conversation. Commands go to Home Assistant's own Assist (/api/conversation/process), so only entities exposed to Assist (Settings → Voice assistants → Expose) can be switched. Devices Assist does not know are switched directly through their service (e.g. switch.turn_on), except locks, alarm systems and updates. With a code word ("Ich" window → Smart home) the assistant switches only when the code word is in the same message ("lights off, code word sunflower"); without it, it asks. The panel checks this itself, not the language model; the model and the stored conversations see only "[Codewort]", it is stored encrypted and compared with some tolerance for speech recognition (a letter or two off, "Apollo 13" = "Apollo dreizehn"). Questions need no code word. Also (ideas from ha-mcp): history

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant
text: ("how warm was it in the bathroom yesterday?"), several devices at once ("all lights in the living room off", each checked; an unknown room never switches the whole home), typo-tolerant device search and to-do lists such as the shopping list (read, add, tick off; changes need the code word). Questions about values, states, zones and where someone is are read directly (/api/states) instead: the assistant sees every device, sensor, zone and person the token's user may see, exposed or not. Home Assistant tells rooms (areas) only to an admin token; without admin rights devices are found by their names only. Only that profile can use its Home Assistant: guests never, and a voice recognized by speaker identification at someone else's device neither. The token is checked before saving, stays on the Spark (users/<id>/homeassistant.json, mode 0600) and is never sent back to the browser.

head: Voice chat
title: Searching conversations
text: Searching conversations: the magnifier next to the conversation list (on phones in the menu) searches all earlier conversations, a profile's with a profile, the browser's as a guest. A click opens the conversation at that spot.

head: Voice chat
title: Earlier conversations
text: Earlier conversations (Funktionen → "Frühere Gespräche", on by default; profiles only): the assistant can look up what you talked about before ("what did you tell me about the grill last week?", "what did we talk about yesterday?"), searching only your own profile's saved conversations. Conversations that have been quiet for ten minutes are also read once in the background, while nobody is talking, and up to three lasting facts per conversation go into the profile's memory, marked "automatic" in the "Ich" window, where they can be deleted. Each profile can switch this learning off in the conversation settings ("Learn from conversations"). Once a week (or with "Propose cleanup") the assistant proposes merging duplicate entries and removing outdated ones; nothing changes until you accept the proposal under Ich → Memory. With notifications on, a note is sent.

head: Voice chat
title: Pronunciation
text: Pronunciation: Settings → Speech output → Pronunciation takes one rule per line, e.g. DGX = De Ge Ix. It applies to whole words and to all speech output, Open WebUI included.

head: Voice chat
title: Barge-in
text: Barge-in: while the assistant speaks, the microphone keeps listening. Talking for about a quarter of a second interrupts the answer, and what you said becomes the next question. This relies on the browser's echo cancellation; if the assistant interrupts itself on loud speakers, use headphones or untick "barge in" below the chat.

head: Voice chat
title: Your own voice
text: Your own voice: under Voices you can record a reference straight from the microphone (read the suggested text, about 10 seconds); the panel fills in the transcript with the speech recognition. Cloning needs a Base model (Settings → Speech output → model …-Base), then pick the new voice as the default voice. The default voice is a list that fits the chosen model: CustomVoice shows the built-in speakers, Base your own voices, with VoiceDesign it is locked (the voice comes from the speaking style); a saved name missing from the list stays as "(not in the list)". A German reference gives much steadier German than the built-in speakers, which are not native German speakers. Under Voices, one or all of your own voices can be exported as a ZIP (reference audio and transcript) and imported again on this or another Spark; on a name clash the import renames, replaces or skips.

head: Voice chat
title: Required tools and answer check (V01.0.117)
text: Required tools and answer check (V01.0.117): questions about appointments, mail, reminders, timers, weather, parcels, transit, lists, match results and news have to go through the matching tool (one table NEED_TOOLS in chat.py, also used by the quality test). While the model chooses the tool, the "tool choice" temperature (0.1) applies, the normal one afterwards. The answer check (Settings → Language model, on by default) lets no sentence through for such questions that names a time, date, score or amount that is in no tool result, the question or the conversation so far; instead the assistant says once "Genauere Angaben dazu habe ich nicht." If the model answers without looking anything up, the answer is dropped and the model is asked once more. Both show up in the tool log as "Antwort-Prüfung". General questions without a tool are not checked. Optional: the admin allows "think while choosing tools", each profile switches it on under Me → Conversation (off, never guests).

head: Voice chat
title: Appointments only fresh from the calendar (V01.0.348)
text: Appointments only fresh from the calendar (V01.0.348): "Guten Morgen" on its own (also with "Spark", "wie geht's") counts as asking for the day: the switch files it under the calendar and the first round has to call daily_briefing (without the briefing: calendar_events). Before another request ("Guten Morgen, turn on the light") it does not. Every calendar result marks appointments that have already ended with "(already over)"; briefing and daily overview do not name them as coming up. Once an answer has read the calendar, the answer check takes times, dates and quoted appointment titles only from the question, the instructions and this answer's results, no longer from earlier answers in the conversation, so yesterday's appointments never come back as today's (tool log: "Termin aus früherer Antwort").

head: Voice chat
title: Learning from corrections (V01.0.118)
text: Learning from corrections (V01.0.118): admin switch Features → "Aus Korrekturen lernen" and a switch per profile (Me → Conversation), both off, never guests or another voice. When a message right after an answer starts like a correction ("Nein, …", "Das stimmt nicht", "Du sollst …", at least three words), the model words a short sentence on the side (fixes.py) and the assistant ends with "Soll ich mir merken: …?". It is stored only after a plain yes from the same conversation within 15 minutes. Never proposed: sentences about code words, PINs, passwords, rules, security, confirmations, locks or alarms, world knowledge (scores, amounts) and links; after mail or outside text there is no proposal, and the earlier answer is then not sent along. The tool log shows a "Korrektur" entry; "Send the question to the admin as a test case" puts the corrected question into quality-cases.json (at most 30) and it runs with the quality test: all tools offered, each finds nothing, made-up figures count as a failure. The admin deletes them under Status → Checks → Quality test.

head: Voice chat
title: Language model settings (V01.0.121)
text: Language model settings (V01.0.121): Under Settings → Language model → Advanced the admin sets the history length (4000–64000 characters, default 24000), web searches per answer (1–3, default 2), the time limit for an answer (60–600 s), top_p and presence_penalty (0 = the server's default) and own keywords that require a tool (one line per tool, e.g. web_search: elfmeter, aufstellung; whole words only, at most 20 per tool, the built-in words always stay). "Restore default" fills in the shipped system prompt, "Show the whole prompt" lists all parts in order and marks the fixed ones. With Features → "Own conversation style" (off) each profile can say under Me → Conversation → Answer, in at most 500 characters, how the assistant should talk to it; the text sits below the system prompt and above the fixed rules, never applies to guests or another voice and cannot be changed with a device key. Fixed: tool rules, handling of outside text, code word, locks and the values of background jobs (learning, briefing, mail sorting, room).

head: Voice chat
title: Roles by voice (V01.0.249)
text: Roles by voice (V01.0.249): With the admin switch Features → Own conversation style → Roles by voice (off) every profile adds up to 8 own roles under Me → Conversation → Answer, one per line like "Butler: polite, dry, with British understatement", and switches on "Roles by voice". "Sei jetzt der Butler", "Wechsle zur Rolle Erklärbär" or "Rolle Butler" switch, "Sei wieder normal" ends the role, "Welche Rollen hast du?" lists them. The panel recognizes these sentences with fixed rules only in the person's own latest message and only for a saved name ("Sei leise" stays a normal question); that answer has no tools, the model only says the result. The active role applies on all devices of the profile, sits in the prompt after the own conversation style and before the fixed tool rules, and changes only the tone, never the rules. Never guests or another voice; roles are changed only in the own browser, not with a device key, and the admin's defaults never hand out roles. Log line: "rolle: set - Butler".

head: Voice chat
title: Wikipedia straight away (V01.0.249)
text: Wikipedia straight away (V01.0.249): With the admin switch Features → Web search → Wikipedia straight away (off, works without a SearXNG address too) and the profile switch Me → Conversation → Answer → "Wikipedia straight away" the assistant gets the tool wikipedia. For knowledge questions ("What is a quasar?", "Who was Ada Lovelace?") the panel fetches the intro of the matching article with one request to the MediaWiki API (at most 1,500 characters, answer at most 1 MB) instead of SearXNG and whole pages; the model reads far less and starts sooner. With no hit on de.wikipedia.org it asks en.wikipedia.org; the admin can enter an own address (then without a second try). Answers are kept in memory for 24 hours (at most 300). The article is outside text: wrapped as data, no switching or saving in the same answer afterwards. "Wikipedia" or "Lexikon" in the question requires the tool; with "only web search and memory" for unclear questions Wikipedia is included. Only the search words leave the Spark. Never guests.

head: Voice chat
title: Own Kiwix archive (V01.0.258)
text: Own Kiwix archive (V01.0.258): With the admin switch Features → Web search → "Own Kiwix archive" (off) and an address (best in the home network, e.g. http://192.168.178.20:8080; changing it needs the second sign-in step) plus the profile switch Me → Conversation → Answer → "Own archive (Kiwix)" the assistant looks things up in your kiwix-serve. "Choose books" opens the catalog as a list (V01.0.260): search, language (default German and English, "All languages" or one), kind (Wikipedia, TED, PhET, Docs …), grouped, each book with language, variant (maxi/nopic), article count, size and date; chosen books sit on top as chips with ×. At most 10; without a choice the German and English Wikipedia. The book name is saved without its date (V01.0.261): when the Kiwix replaces a file with a newer one (e.g. …_2025-01 → …_2025-03) the Spark takes the newest automatically; when a book answers 404 it reads the catalog again at once, and "Tell me more" finds the article in the new file. "Look in my archive …" always means the Kiwix, never the uploaded documents; when the archive is not available for the profile the assistant says why (admin switch, address, profile switch) instead of searching th

head: Voice chat
title: Own Kiwix archive (V01.0.258)
text: e documents (log line kiwix: archive asked, not offered). Since V01.0.266 the router also recognises "dein/unser Archiv", "im Archiv" and "Archiv durchsuchen"; when the archive is offered the first round must call exactly archive_search (not the document search). The "not available" note comes only when the admin switched the Kiwix on or "Kiwix" is in the question. The tool wikipedia asks the Kiwix's Wikipedia books first (title suggestion, else full text) and the online Wikipedia only without a hit or when the Kiwix fails; a profile with only the Kiwix switch gets wikipedia without internet. archive_search searches the full text of the chosen books (at most 5 at once) and names the best article with further hits; article_more reads on in one of them (at most 3 parts of 1,500 characters, only by the id a tool named before). If the web search fails (SearXNG unreachable or no search engine answers), the assistant answers from the Kiwix and says it comes from the offline archive (with its date) and holds nothing current. Security: addresses only from the admin's address plus fixed endpoints (/catalog/v2/entries, /suggest, /search, /content/<book>/…), redirects only to the same host an

head: Voice chat
title: Own Kiwix archive (V01.0.258)
text: d inside the book, netguard HOME (home network allowed, own ports and link-local never), answers at most 1 MB (articles 4 MB), 10 s, XML with a DOCTYPE is refused, HTML only turned into text (no scripts, tables, footnotes). Everything is outside text. Answers are kept 24 hours in memory (at most 300), the catalog an hour. Status → Checks → "Check Kiwix" shows reachability, books and a test search; Logs → area "Knowledge" shows kiwix: lines with book, hits and time, never the question. Never guests.

head: Voice chat
title: Look locally first (V01.0.264)
text: Look locally first (V01.0.264): With the admin switch Features → Web search → "Look locally first" (off; time limit 200 to 1500 ms, default 400) and the profile switch Me → Conversation → Answer → "Look locally first" the Spark itself first looks in the own sources for knowledge questions before anything goes out. A fixed rule (lokal.py, never the model) sorts the person's message: outside (web search asked for, weather, trains, parcels, news, prices, rates, "today", "right now", years from 2020 …) goes straight out as before, without delay; local (an own source named: "in my documents", "in the archive", "we talked about", "last time") searches only there, the web search is left out of this answer (a new message can ask for it); a knowledge question (anything else with search words) gets the quick look. It asks the own and shared documents (full text; meaning search only when that model already runs and is free), the own Kiwix (title suggestion, else full text, only articles whose title fits the question) and the earlier conversations (without answers from mail, without the current conversation) at the same time. What is not back by the time limit is not waited for. A passage coun

head: Voice chat
title: Look locally first (V01.0.264)
text: ts only when it holds at least 60 % of the search words (question words like "who", "how high" do not count). At most 3 hits of 500 characters each go to the model in the first round as the tool result local_search, wrapped as outside text: data, never an instruction, and the answer is locked like one from the web (no switching, saving, reminders). The model names the source briefly ("In your documents …", "According to your archive …"); when nothing fits it answers timeless questions from its own knowledge or searches the web. It only looks where the answer may look anyway (the tools document_search, archive_search, history_search of this turn): guests, a voice not recognised at a shared speaker and Telegram without personal data get no quick look. Web search after documents: without the switch it is locked after a document; with it, it stays possible, but the panel sends only the words of the question (without code word, at most 120 characters), never the model's query. After mail it stays locked. Status → Checks → "Test looking locally first" shows class, search words, hits per source and times for one sentence (admin, 20 per minute); Logs → area "Knowledge" shows one lokal: lin

head: Voice chat
title: Look locally first (V01.0.264)
text: e per question with class, hits per source, time and what happens next, never the question.

head: Voice chat
title: reMarkable notes (V01.0.273)
text:
reMarkable notes (V01.0.273): A profile connects its my.remarkable account (reMarkable 2, Paper Pro, Paper Pro Move); the assistant then finds the picked notebooks in the document search, also with meaning search, document card and "Look locally first". Switches: Features → Own documents → Read pictures and scans → "reMarkable notes" (admin, off) and Ich → reMarkable → "reMarkable for me" (profile, off); never guests. Pairing: get a one-time code for a desktop app on my.remarkable.com (eight letters) and enter it under Ich → reMarkable (own browser only, never with a device key; with the second sign-in step a fresh code).
